campaign_coverage: history breadth/pairs bounded to 512; unvisited and longer traces remain uncovered
offline/revoked-device access and retained history require device boundary qualification
paired observations exclude wire sequences/receipts, physical timing and resource/meter differences; HTTP and device histories require separate qualification
unauthenticated HTTP attempts require a live server; engine principals are authenticated contexts
exclusions: physical timing, examined counts and resource/meter side channels
offline access may use a snapshot predating server revocation
